description: This PHP class 'Returns' handles the sending of email notifications related to product returns in the admin area of an OpenCart e-commerce platform. It loads models, retrieves return and order information, and queues email tasks based on return events.

classes.name: Returns
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling email notifications related to returns in the admin area.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that processes return data and queues email notification tasks if mailing is enabled, including retrieving return and order info, preparing email content, and scheduling the email task.
